description: This file contains utility functions and types for managing Slack allowlists, including normalization, caching, and matching logic.

classes.name: SlackAllowListMatch
classes.description: Type representing different match types for Slack allowlist entries.

methods.name: normalizeSlackSlug
methods.description: Normalizes a Slack slug with caching to improve performance.

methods.name: normalizeAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of strings or numbers for allowlist processing.

methods.name: normalizeAllowListLower
methods.description: Normalizes and converts a list of strings or numbers to lowercase for allowlist processing.

methods.name: normalizeSlackAllowOwnerEntry
methods.description: Processes and validates a Slack owner entry string.

methods.name: resolveSlackAllowListMatch
methods.description: Resolves the best match from an allowlist based on provided Slack user info.

methods.name: allowListMatches
methods.description: Checks if a given Slack user info matches the allowlist.

methods.name: resolveSlackUserAllowed
methods.description: Determines if a Slack user is allowed based on the allowlist and user info.
